deferral_rationale: Reconciler downgrade (code-review r1, epm:review-reconcile v1): the OSError-to-no-evidence fall-through and the naive-ts reap direction are plan v4 s1(b)/s2 VERBATIM (deliberate recorded degradations: a missed keep = the #2223 recreate-a-worktree inconvenience; bytes stay protected by the #2246 unmerged probe + tracked-changes guard, both fail-toward-keep). The uncontained TypeError (unhashable kind under frozenset membership), UnicodeDecodeError (escapes the OSError-only catch), and ValueError (bare env-float parse) are verified real by probe, but all three CRASH the sweep with NOTHING reaped — the fail-safe direction for a destructive janitor; the UnicodeDecodeError + env-float exposures are byte-parity with pre-existing main patterns (_merged_evidence's identical utf-8 read under an OSError-only catch; _venv_idle_days' identical bare float()), and the unhashable-kind TypeError is reachable only via a hand-corrupted events.jsonl (task.py writes string kinds + UTF-8 by construction). The diff strictly ADDS keep branches: no named failure makes the reaper more destructive than pre-diff main. Hardening recorded as a standing recommendation in the reconcile verdict.
